## Background

<!-- CHANGE THIS -->

Master student of Urban Spatial Analytics (MUSA) at the Weitzman School of Design, University of Pennsylvania, taking my practice deeper into the data behind the design.

Trained as both an architect and urbanist, I transform climate science into adaptive urban strategies that treat environmental change not as a threat, but as a catalyst for resilience. I design with water flow, seasonal flooding, and ecological shift, not against them.

My work spans projected climate scenarios, participatory planning, and interventions like floodable landscapes and climate-adaptive urban foodscapes. Always at the intersection of environmental data, policy, and design, and always in pursuit of strategies that are equitable, not just forward-thinking.
